translations.web: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.
translations.bsb: They will be made to stumble, their own tongues turned against them. All who see will shake their heads.
translations.kjv: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.
translations.asv: So they shall be made to stumble, their own tongue being against them: All that see them shall wag the head.
